ap.title: Approvals
ap.defaultDesc: Asks when an action needs you. What you allow in this chat, your rules and your hooks can let actions run without asking.
ap.strictShort: Asks before commands, file changes, changing web requests, computer actions, images and notifications; helpers, your hooks and MCP servers stay off.
ap.why.q: What never asks, even with Ask every time?
ap.why.a: Reading, searching and tasks never ask, and saving memory and TODO edits do not ask either.
ap.busy: It is working or waiting for you now. Change approvals when this reply ends.
ap.wait: Another change to this chat is being saved or checked. Change approvals when it is done.
ap.noRevision: This computer's agent didn't say which version of the approvals it holds, so they can't be changed here.
ap.readFailed: This chat's approvals couldn't be read.
ap.conflict: The approvals changed meanwhile, so nothing was changed. They were read again: choose again.
ap.unsatisfiable: This chat can't use Ask every time: what it runs with answers some approvals itself.
ap.policyLocked: Set by this computer's policy, so it can't be changed here.
ap.yoloOn: On. Actions that would ask you run without asking. Deny rules still win, and questions still wait for you.
ap.yoloOff: Off. Actions that need you ask first.
ap.yoloConfirmBody: The Agent on {{computer}} will run every action in this chat without asking you first, as you: commands, file changes and deletions, and some actions normally kept for a person. Deny rules still win. Questions, hooks that ask and connected tool servers that confirm each call still wait for you.
ap.yoloRefused: Allow everything is off while approvals are set to Ask every time or locked.
